title: The Wise Parrot
introduction: ‘The Wise Parrot’ is treated as an inquiry-based learning unit. The chapter connects freedom and care, communication among birds, intelligence and problem solving, responsible treatment of animals, listening and acting on information. Learners observe the situation, identify evidence, explain relationships, consider consequences and apply the learning to a new context without reproducing textbook wording.
